messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Utkarsh Singh

utkarsh singh... solid name. has that "i'm definitely going places" energy.

where you working these days?
HackerEarth

hackerearth... the coding platform that's been around since the early days. building where developers test their skills and companies hunt for talent.

found you on linkedin - utkarsh singh, web developer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/utkarsh-singh-4bb919311
No
ah wrong utkarsh. let me try again - what do you do at hackerearth? that'll help me find the right profile
I'm a frontend Engineer
frontend engineer at hackerearth... still getting the same profile though. can't find you. drop your linkedin url or resume - i need at least one to find you roles. can't match you blind
https://www.linkedin.com/in/utkarsh-singh-592b52137

perfect. frontend at hackerearth... building the platform where millions of developers prove their worth. that's solid work. 

what made you get into frontend? the visual side of building or just fell into it?

Honestly, I got into frontend because the visual side of building things always attracted me. I love seeing ideas turn into something you can interact with instantly. It started out as something I just explored out of curiosity, but once I saw how creative and fast-feedback the frontend world is, I naturally fell into it and stuck with it.

that instant feedback loop is addictive fr. code → refresh → see magic happen. no waiting around for builds or deployments to see if your idea works.

how long you been working total?
2.5 years

2.5 years... past the "junior who breaks everything" phase but still in that sweet spot where you're hungry and learning fast.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Senior frontend Engineer.. or an SDE 2 frontend

senior frontend / sde 2... ambitious. 2.5 years to senior is doable if you've been shipping real stuff and not just ticket monkey work.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Mostly remote.. else bangalore
2.5 years + senior frontend / sde 2 + remote first, bangalore backup... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

you're officially in the tal system, utkarsh! 

frontend roles that actually pay well and don't treat you like a css monkey are coming your way. remote-first companies that get it, plus some solid bangalore options as backup.

time to level up from hackerearth to something that'll make your github commits worth 6 figures 🔥

welcome to the squad, legend
Thanks
you're welcome. now go build something cool while i work my magic 🚀
How will this work?
i share roles that fit your profile, you apply through the link. no magic, just good opportunities.
I'll have to apply?
yep, you apply directly through the link. everyone goes through the same process.
You can't apply for me?
nope, can't apply for you. i share the link, you do the applying. that's how it works.

Ok
  Hi
  Hey
what's up?
When will you send the jobs?
when my team sends something that fits your profile. could be tomorrow, could be next week.
Will it be high paying
depends on the company and role. i'll only share what's worth your time.
Okay.. till then can you teach me typescript
typescript is just javascript with a seatbelt. start with the basics: interfaces, types, generics. what's your current level?
Basic
start with typescript playground. write js, add types. interfaces for objects, generics for reusable functions. practice for 30 mins daily.
that's the face of someone who's about to become a typescript pro.
Right
exactly. now go type some stuff.

found a frontend role at a startup called coderound ai

they're building from scratch with react/next/typescript, weekly shipping

founding engineer role so massive ownership, but early stage

hey, found a frontend dev role at CodeRound AI

they're looking for a founding engineer to build from scratch with react/next/typescript

could be a high-ownership move from hackerearth, but it's early stage

Hi
Hey
what's up?
Nothing much
just chilling on a friday night? what's the vibe at hackerearth these days
Work almost got over
nice. what got you into frontend in the first place?
I want to switch for career progression
I told you that

oh right, the visual side - seeing ideas turn into interactive things. creative and fast feedback.

i remember now. that's what makes frontend special - you build something and immediately see it come alive.

so what's making you want to leave hackerearth anyway?
what does progression actually look like for you? like what would make you feel like you're moving forward?
Better pay
what's your current pay and what number would actually change things for you?
Current is 13.2 lpa..
and what's the target? what number would make you feel like you're actually progressing?
25 or more.. I'll be promoted next feb.. so I'll be expecting more

got it. 13.2 → 25+ is a solid jump. you're thinking senior frontend roles should get you there.

what's the promotion timeline looking like? feb is what, 2 months away?
Yes 2 months away

okay so you're playing both sides - seeing what's out there while waiting for that feb promotion bump.

smart move. gives you leverage either way.

what's the notice period at hackerearth?
2 months

2 months notice lines up perfectly with feb promotion timeline. companies know they'd have to wait anyway.

so you're looking remote first, bangalore if not. anything else about the setup that matters?
Like what

like hybrid vs fully remote, office expectations, team distribution... some companies say "remote" but mean "come in once a week" or "we're all in one city but you can work from home"

what's your ideal setup?
If the office is more than once a week.. I'm not fine with it

got it. fully remote or max once a week. that's the filter.

what's the salary range you're targeting? current and what you want next
More than 25 lpa

perfect. 25+ LPA, remote-first, senior frontend. that's the filter.

anything specific you're avoiding? companies, industries, tech stacks?
Nope

clean slate. i like it.

last thing - what's your notice period? and when's the earliest you could start if something perfect came through?
2 months.. probably after feb

alright you're locked in.

senior frontend, 25+ LPA, remote-first, bangalore if not, 2 months notice, feb promotion timeline.

i'll slide roles when they're good. i'm picky about what i share - nothing that doesn't actually fit.

btw what's making you want to leave hackerearth anyway? just growth or something else?
Just growth

makes sense. 2.5 years in, hitting senior, time for the next level.

what does growth actually mean to you? bigger scope? more complex problems? leadership? or just the title/salary bump?
And 4 days a week office

ohhh that's the real tea.

4 days in office is brutal. especially for frontend where everything's remote-friendly.

so it's growth AND getting your life back. remote work = more time, less commute, better balance.

that's a solid reason. i'll keep an eye out for companies that actually get remote culture, not just tolerate it.

anything else about hackerearth that's pushing you out?
No

got it. growth + remote freedom. that's the combo.

i'm scanning for senior frontend roles that actually pay 25+ and understand remote work. early stage startups, scaleups, maybe some remote-first established companies.

anything specific you're excited to work on? any tech you're itching to use more?
Not specifically.. let's see what comes

perfect. i'll keep it open.

you're in the system now. i'll ping when something actually fits - not just any job, but something that matches your growth + remote combo.

enjoy your friday night.

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
